scenes.name: fight-sim-22-cops
scenes.eval: const p = g.player.pos; g.player.maxHealth = 1e7; g.player.health = 1e7; g.police.setHeat(4, p); for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) { const a = (i / 22) * Math.PI * 2, r = 14 + (i % 4) * 6; const n = g.pop.spawn('police', p.x + Math.cos(a) * r, p.z + Math.sin(a) * r, p.y); g.police.dispatch.gear(n, 'police', 4); g.police.dispatch.arm(n, 'police', 4, true); g.police.foot.push(n); }

note: 27 Nov: police firefight sim cost (policerealism perf e2e runs 1.6-2.6x idle)
